notes.title: SUPER ALICE DOLLS　Updated to the full release version!（ver1.00）
notes.notes:
→1.00
Extra World! of 8W is added for a total of 16W. 
We are happy if you can play without any difficulty as we have added some hard and fun levels!

The condition on the Extra World is that you must have completed 8-4 & obtained at least 32 magic books.
You do not have to have cleared the additional stages that open up with your score item.

Thank you for your interest from Early Access!
Although we have set the version as ver 1.00, we will continue to make adjustments based on the feedback we receive from players.
We will make this a fun game and look forward to working with you in the future!
The additional stages on the back side are more difficult. Please challenge them when you are well!

I am a little confused about the sale settings and had the sale set up from 8/5 to 8/19,
It seems there is a separate setting for the release, and since I can't do that, Steam won't show the full release!
Please understand. We will be quietly displaying the full release soon.

■Other Updates
The sound of getting hit has been added.
I was able to defeat the alter ego of the 4-4 boss after hitting the karakuri doll about 5 times.
Some bug fixes and adjustments have been made.

notes.title: It will be updated to the completed version on 8/5!
notes.notes:
Thank you for staying with us from Early Access.
We plan to update to the finalized version on 8/5.
Add 8W on the extra side for a total of 16W.
We hope you will fight for more dangerous and fun stages!

It is treated as a completed version, but we are adding achievements for the first time, 
so we have not been able to test that area yet.

We will test it after release, so please understand that there may be some glitches.

We have been fixing bugs and making adjustments since Early Access,
Some of the additional stages can be quite challenging.
If you play with the game and find that there are many tough situations, we would like to make adjustments, such as strengthening Alice further.

I'm sure I'll still be updating things, but I'd be happy to keep you posted!
